card.name: Linking words after warning phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words ("of", "with", "a") that come right after a warning phrase in label text, such as "reproductive potential" or a named syndrome, just before the risk is stated.

modes.label: "of" after reproductive potential
modes.description: The word "of" after "females of reproductive potential" in embryo-fetal toxicity advice, just before "the potential risk to a fetus".
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential<< of>> the potential risk to a fetus and use

modes.label: "a" opening an appositive
modes.description: The word "a" after a condition name and comma, starting a short description of it.
modes.example: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS),<< a>> potentially fatal symptom complex, has been reported

modes.label: "with" after associated
modes.description: The word "with" after "associated" when linking a drug to an adverse effect.
